section.content: 本公开的半导体集成电路包括：与受保护电路连接的第电源线和第二电源线；被供给有与供给到第电源线和第二电源线的电压不同的电压的第三电源线；连接在所述第电源线和第二电源线之间并检测在所述第电源线中产生的浪涌的检测电路；包括串联连接的至少个反相器并且连接在所述第电源线和第二电源线之间的反相器电路；连接在所述第电源线和第二电源线之间并且受到所述检测电路的输出控制使得所述浪涌流过第二电源线的保护晶体管；和至少与所述第三电源线和所述保护晶体管连接的时间常数电路。

The semiconductor integrated circuit of the disclosure includes：The first power line and second source line being connected with protected circuit；It is supplied with the 3rd power line of the voltages different from the voltage for being supplied to the first power line and second source line；It is connected between first power line and second source line and detects the detection circuit of the surge produced in first power line；Including at least one phase inverter being connected in series and the inverter circuit being connected between first power line and second source line；It is connected between first power line and second source line and by the output control for detecting circuit so that the surge flows through the protection transistor of second source line；The time constant circuit being at least connected with the 3rd power line and the protection transistor.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

This disclosure relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit including eliminating the circuit of the surge produced in power line.

Background technology

Generally, the semiconductor integrated circuit such as large scale integrated circuit (LSI) is small-sized with semiconductor integrated circuit Change the reduction with voltage and increase internal circuit (hereinafter, be referred to as protected circuit) of the protection with predetermined function and exempt from The importance influenceed by the surge produced in power line.

By the static discharge (ESD) of the outside terminal relative to power line, power line voltage increased dramatically, i.e. ESD waves Gush as the representative surge produced in power line but it is known.

In order to which the high voltage pulse for preventing ESD surges from being produced in outside terminal damages protected circuit, for ESD protections Device or circuit together with protected circuit it is integrated on a semiconductor substrate.

For example, as the device or circuit protected for ESD, GGMOS (MOS of grounded-grid), IGCT and RCMOS are It is known.Although the device or circuit protected for ESD are suitably used according to purpose, in recent years commonly using design The relatively simple esd protection circuit (for example, referenced patent document 1 and non-patent literature 1) constituted with RCMOS.

Citation list

Patent document

Patent document 1：Japanese Unexamined Patent Application Publication No.2012-253266

Non-patent literature

Non-patent literature 1：C.A.Torres et al；“Modular,Portable,and Easily Simulated ESD Protection Networks for Advanced CMOS Technologies ", Electrical Overstress/Electrostatic Discharge Symposium, September 11~13.Symposium Proceedings, pp.81~94, Fig.1.

The content of the invention

As the esd protection circuit constituted with RCMOS, wherein being provided with detection between power supply wiring and ground connection distribution The composition of circuit, inverter circuit and protection transistor is known.In the composition, detection circuit uses resistor and electricity Container, inverter circuit uses CMOS, and protects transistor that the surge produced in power supply wiring is delivered into ground connection distribution. MOS transistor is used as protection transistor.

In the esd protection circuit constituted with above-mentioned RCMOS, when producing surge, protection transistor is passed to wave Gush from power supply wiring and be delivered to ground connection distribution.When no surge is produced, protection transistor is closed and in holding state.So And, even if when the MOS transistor as protection transistor is in cut-off state, can also produce cut-off leakage current, and cut Stopping leak leakage current causes the power consumption under holding state to increase.Therefore, it is desirable to reduce cut-off leakage current.

Patent document 1 is proposed：In the esd protection circuit constituted with RCMOS, by the way that inverter circuit will be arranged on One end of phase inverter in afterbody is connected to the 3rd power line different from power supply wiring and ground connection distribution to reduce cut-off Leakage current.However, in the circuit described in patent document 1, when producing surge, overcurrent may flow through and the 3rd power line The phase inverter of connection, so as to cause the forfeiture of ESD defencive functions.

Accordingly, it is desired to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, it can reduce normal while ESD defencive functions are maintained Power consumption during operation.

Included according to the semiconductor integrated circuit of disclosure embodiment：The first power line for being connected with protected circuit and Second source line；It is supplied with the 3rd electricity of the voltages different from the voltage for being supplied to first power line and second source line Source line；It is connected to the surge that between first power line and second source line and detection is produced in first power line Detect circuit；Including at least one phase inverter being connected in series and it is connected between first power line and second source line Inverter circuit；It is connected between first power line and second source line and by the output control of the detection circuit System causes the surge to flow through the protection transistor of the second source line；At least with the 3rd power line and the protection The time constant circuit of transistor connection.

In the semiconductor integrated circuit according to disclosure embodiment, time constant circuit and the 3rd power line and protection Transistor is connected, so that reducing the cut-off leakage current of protection transistor.

In the semiconductor integrated circuit according to disclosure embodiment, time constant circuit and the 3rd power line and protection Transistor is connected.This allows to the cut-off leakage current for reducing protection transistor, and can maintain ESD defencive functions The power consumption during normal operating is reduced simultaneously.

It is pointed out that the effect recorded here is nonrestrictive.The effect realized by this technology can be this public affairs Open the one or more in described effect.
